annotations.title: Confirm or reject a suggested account match

description: Confirm (same person) or reject (not them) Odin's suggestion that a tool's account belongs to an organisation member, as the people view does. Works for Linear, Jira, GitLab, Shortcut, Notion and Slack. Confirming a Slack account makes it act as that member through @Odin, so it needs identity verification and is refused here: send the user to the Integrations page. Rejecting one works here. Owners and admins only. Not available to every organisation yet, and refused until it is.
